svg.title: About Rakibul Islam Hasib
svg.desc: How I work: design, build, ship, refine. Right now: software developer at AiOpsCamp. Currently learning Server Components and the App Router, database architecture with Mongoose, and React performance. Based in Bangladesh, UTC+6, open to collaborations. Words I code by: “Code is like humor. When you have to explain it, it’s bad.” Cory House.
